So your comfortable enough in your clothing that you've never felt it interfere with your comfort or operation. This is the state of a lot of people, most in fact. Some people find some aspects drag them down or restricting while others feel entirely alien and uncomfortable to the point that they can't operate normally without pain and humiliation.

I myself find my male gender comfortable, and I've seen my older brother struggle with it early in his life when he was coming to terms with being gay. He wasn't uncomfortable in his gender but operating in friend groups of teenagers and young adults when so much discussion is focused on sex or at least relationships is difficult. I imagine that someone who isn't even comfortable with day to day existing instead of simple social actions would be unbearable.

Dealing with that as a child who doesn't have access to the emotional controls needed to deal with that extreme discomfort sounds like a nightmare to me. People who attack such vulnerable young people should be added to some kind of watch list, because they elicit so little empathy that I'd be wary of such a person in my neighbourhood, for the same reason animal cruelty is about finding out who lacks the most basic empathic traits.
